_note: State election office result sites to read when there is no AP/DDHQ key. Ships EMPTY: each state's 2026 results URL is only known once the state publishes it on election night. Supported type: 'clarity' (Clarity/Scytl ENR sites). Example entry: { "state": "XX", "type": "clarity", "url": "https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/XX/<electionId>/", "name": "XX Secretary of State", "source_url": "<public results page>" }. Contests are matched to races by name (U.S. Senate, Governor, U.S. House district N, ballot questions). State sites do not call races.
